QuestInfo.name: Charms for Info
QuestInfo.1: Bruce wants additional information about Golems from Roca, the Cygnus informant, but Roca wants 3 Zombie Mushmom Charms in return. Defeat Zombie Mushmoms at the Zombie Mushmom Hill off the Ghost Mushroom Path. Collect 3 charms and deliver them to Roca.
QuestInfo.2: You defeated the Zombie Mushmoms got the 3 charms, and delivered them to Roca. Roca didn't seem to trust you, though, and insisted on speaking to Dr. Bruce directly. Whatever.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: EXP 1,200 Can proceed to The Frozen Golems quest

0.0: I'm sort of at a wall here, so I asked Roca for help. I'm already regretting it though, he wants 3 Zombie Mushmom Charms for his information! I thought Cygnus Knights were supposed to be noble, but he was a total weirdo. Oh well, this is why I hired an assistant!\r\n

yes.0: Judging by the name, you should probably go to Zombie Mushmom Hill. It's right off of the Ghost Mushroom Path. Certainly it will be a sunny and beautiful place! Take the Charms over to Roca when you're done. He's sitting around by Maya's house.

no.0: But, there is science to be done! I knew I should have given this job to that evil robot lady.

1.0: Well helloooo! Yoooou must be DOCTOR Bruce's assistant.\r\n#L0##bI, uh, yes. Here are the Charms you wanted. Give me that info!#l\n#k
1.1: Oh, I can't do that! What makes YOU think I can just GIVE this information to somebody like yoooou? I don't know that you are Doctor Bruce's assistant. What if you're just a SPY with a handful of CHARMS? I will deliver the neeeews directly. Yooou can go away now, thanks!
